question: 在历史大盘股可核年度报表类别内，局部相邻动量时按经营盈利选择，是否改善下一月排序、收益、亏损风险或操作负担？

timing.annual: June anchor last SPY session on or before June30; acceptance no later than that session minus 2 calendar days; July uses current June, January through June use previous June
timing.period: latest rounded fiscal period in anchor year minus 1; select latest accepted 10-K/10-K/A before qualifying, never fall back to an older qualified submission
timing.momentum: P(month-end m-2)/P(month-end m-13)-1, 12 valid endpoints spanning 11 complete month returns; skip most recent month
timing.label: formed close to target month-end total-return adjusted price ratio; no claim of tradable same-close execution

admission.inputs: B v5 source-qualified accounting candidates, root identity decision, candidate manual-action qualification
admission.decision_only: Only identity/source/accounting/momentum/formation quote known-at-formation tests admit rows. Target missing/exit/target action unknown never changes membership/pairs/selections.
admission.duplicate_issuer: keep one security per CIK, alphabetic exact frozen historical ticker; log alternatives; never based on future outcome
admission.source_scope: Historical S&P500 membership reconstructed from current public snapshots; qualified accounting structure, not full market/PIT vendor arrival proof.

pairing.odd_omission: t=12*(target_year-2015)+target_month-1; omit 1-based rank 1+2*(t mod ((n+1)//2)); remaining adjacent ranks paired
pairing.op_tie: use higher_momentum selection; no directed high-minus-low claim for equal OP
pairing.momentum_tie: both momentum baselines choose lexicographically first ticker
pairing.formation_weights: each pair gets 1/K; select one name per pair; full pool includes odd unpaired member for rank description; no loss-driven re-pairing

outcomes.ordinary: only qualified exact ticker end quotes with no unresolved target action; adj_end/adj_formation-1
outcomes.exits: all unresolved economic-right/cash/share/dividend cases remain null, with acquired primary terms saved; no last-price/zero imputation
outcomes.same_choice: increment=0 algebraically even if return null; policy return and own loss status remain null
outcomes.different_choice: increment known only if both selected returns known; save sum_known_delta/K, mean_identifiable_delta, unknown_delta_count/K separately
outcomes.return_bounds: none for unknown mean return; do not invent finite upside cap
outcomes.loss_bounds: loss=return<0; unknown may be 0 or1; same selected ticker cancels; pair delta interval uses shared identity

metrics.primary: monthly profitability-minus-higher_momentum mean among identifiable pair differences, with original-weight known contribution and unknown weight; joint comparison to lower_momentum mandatory
secondary: raw monthly Spearman rank correlation of OP with observed target returns, average ranks for ties
OP higher-minus-lower within pair, exclude OP-ties from directed contrast but retain all pairs in policy delta
loss part min(r,0) and upside part max(r,0), pairwise differences and algebraic sum
four sign cells: both nonnegative, both negative, profitability negative/opponent nonnegative, profitability nonnegative/opponent negative; count/sum/mean per opponent
own loss-event probability ranges and pair shared-identity difference ranges
monthly method mean, standard deviation, worst-decile mean only on months with every selected return known for ALL THREE methods; full-pool cumulative strategy/maxdrawdown not computed
every monthly momentum absolute gap median/max; full and paired sample counts; agreement/switch proportions
monthly target-name and equal target-weight change (0.5 L1) for 119 transitions; not drift-adjusted turnover or fees
monthly OP-MOM rank correlation and count of selected original annual reports/newly changed filings for information overlap and maintenance

uncertainty.method: circular moving blocks of 12 calendar months; sample ceil(N/12) uniform start indices, concatenate modulo N and take first N; preserve every calendar month and all method/missing columns together
uncertainty.interval: 2.5 and97.5 percentile of corresponding statistic; no significance threshold as automatic adoption
uncertainty.main: Full120-month statistics; two 60-month slices descriptive only, no additional parameter fits

method_amendment_before_results: Sparse monthly candidate count13..25 prevents5x3groups; use fixed adjacent pairing and both momentum directions. Extra partial linear correlation removed before results per Astra review.
source_version_limit: Current reconstructed historical files, historical accession acceptance retained; cannot certify all historical vendors/revisions/issuers by matching names alone.
output: new external matched-op-effect-v1 directory only; originals unchanged
